LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_TreasureMap.label: treasure map
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_TreasureMap.description: Old coordinates and rumors of gemstones. Place the map on the ground, then select a colonist and right-click it to decipher. Consumed only when a new site is successfully found. Up to four expeditions may be active at once.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_TreasureChest.label: sealed treasure chest
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_TreasureChest.descripti: A heavy old chest. Select a colonist and right-click to open it. Its physical contents are stored inside and placed nearby when opened. Destroying it also releases surviving contents.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_DecoyChest.label: suspicious gilded chest
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_DecoyChest.description: Its suspiciously bright gilding is peeling, with fresh footprints nearby. It may be a cheap decoy containing ordinary metal instead of promised gemstones.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_WarningSign.label: traces of an earlier expedition
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_WarningSign.description: A note, marks on metal and scraps of wiring. Select this object and read its inspection text for clues to traps and genuine treasure.
